creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Two related gaps, both in the path an agent hits most:

didYouMean only fires when the name is spelled right and used with the wrong
accessor. A real typo - c.Text("ARGSS") - gets no help at all, which is worse
than the parser's version of the same mistake. Schemas here are small enough that
listing the declared names beats guessing at one: exhaustive, unambiguous, and no
edit-distance code to carry.

A missing snapshot directory gets a bare OS error while an empty one right beside
it in the code gets a written, actionable message. Match them.

Keep the existing kind hint - naming which bucket a section was declared under is
the single most useful thing we say on that path.
title: Sharpen the diagnostics for a name the schema does not know
